g.text: 1. Pipe/fittings/flanges per class B2 (CFU-000-PI-SPC-001); BW fittings ASME B16.9, flanges B16.5/B16.47A RF.
2. Hydrotest 6.6 barg per ASME B31.3 345.4 (vents at high points, drains at low points).
3. PWHT: YES - all thk (P-No.5B, B31.3 Tbl 331.1.1) 705-770 C. NDE: 100 % RT of BW; 100 % MT/PT of fillets; HB <= 241; 100 % PMI.
4. Supports: RS rest/shoe, GD guide, ANC anchor, SPR variable spring - tags PS-<area><seq>-nn.
5. Welds: dot = shop weld, crossed circle FW = field weld; spools <= 12 m for transport.
6. Pump suction: no pockets, header falls to pumps; eccentric reducers 14"x10" FLAT ON TOP; temporary strain
7. Pump nozzle 10" assumed (API 610 vendor data pending).
8. Line exits C-101 skirt through 1000 mm access sleeve; hot (390 C) - skirt opening insulated.
9. NPSHa per mech. data sheet; suction line kept short (< 15 m developed per pump).
ISOMETRIC VIEW - NOT TO SCALE - DIMENSIONS IN mm, ELEVATIONS / COORDINATES IN m (PLANT GRID)
100 % RT of BW; 100 % MT/PT of fillets;
CAT 1 - T > 300 C & NPS >= 6; T > 200 C & NPS >= 1
P / L Atmospheric residue to P
